newsitem.title: UK: Baltic Freight Index rises 9 to 1,490.
newsitem.headline: Baltic Freight Index rises 9 to 1,490.

text.p: The spot Baltic Freight Index (BFI) rose nine points on Tuesday to 1,490.

Brokers said the difference between the early position in the U.S. Gulf/Atlantic and April loading was illustrated by Halla's fixuture of CSK Fortune for 52,000 tonnes heavy grain prompt U.S. Gulf/Japan at a lower $24.50 no combo and Oldendorff's fixture of Kiyoh 71,800 tonnes dwt delivery Bremen 5/10 April trip via Baltimore to Japan at $16,250 daily.
They said firm conditions were seen throughout the far east for Panamaxes and Capers. Meamwhile, the Baltic Handy index was up three at 1,103 in a quiet market.
